summary.zh: 生成指向真实文件和行号的步骤式代码讲解
summary.en: Write a step-by-step walkthrough with real files and line numbers

description.zh: 把一段代码拆成按顺序展开的导览步骤，每一步都指向真实存在的文件和行号，也能输出 CodeTour 的 .tour 文件。适合新人上手、讲清架构、做 PR 走查，或解释某个功能如何运作时使用。
description.en: Turns a codebase or pull request into ordered walkthrough steps that point at real files and line numbers, and can emit a CodeTour .tour file. Use it for onboarding, architecture explanations or guided PR review.
